Aug 18, 2026

Enjoy 20% Cashback Through Checkout by Fonepay on Jeevee

Online shopping just got a little easier, and a lot more rewarding. 

Checkout by Fonepay is now live on Jeevee App, giving shoppers a faster and simpler way to complete their online purchases. To celebrate the launch, Fonepay and Jeevee are also bringing an exclusive 20% cashback offer, making this the perfect time to shop your favorites on Jeevee. 

A Faster Way to Check Out 

We all love finding the right product online, but the checkout process can sometimes add unnecessary steps to an otherwise seamless shopping experience. 

With Checkout by Fonepay, Jeevee customers can now complete their payments directly through the checkout journey, without the usual hassle of switching between different apps or going through multiple payment steps. 

The result? A smoother shopping experience from adding your favorite products to your cart to completing your payment. 

And now, there’s even more reason to give it a try. 

Get 20% Cashback on Your Jeevee Orders 

To celebrate the integration of Checkout by Fonepay, Jeevee and Fonepay have launched a special cashback campaign for shoppers. 

From 18 August to 31 August 2026, customers who shop on Jeevee and complete their payment using Checkout by Fonepay can enjoy: 

🎁 20% Cashback Up to NPR 500 

Here’s what you need to know: 

  • 20% cashback on payments done via Checkout by Fonepay 

  • Maximum cashback of NPR 500 per customer 

  • Cashback is available until 31 August 2026 or until the campaign budget is exhausted, whichever comes first 

  • Fonepay checkout transactions initiated from Fonepay app will not be eligible for the cashback. 

So whether you’ve been waiting to pick up something from your wishlist or simply need to restock your everyday essentials, this is a great time to shop on Jeevee and save while you pay. 

How to Get the Cashback 

Getting started is simple. 

Step 1: Browse and shop for your favorite products on Jeevee. 

Step 2: Proceed to checkout and select Checkout by Fonepay as your payment method. 

Step 3: Complete your payment through a participating mobile banking application. 

Step 4: Enjoy 20% cashback, up to NPR 500, subject to the campaign terms and available budget. 

Checkout by Fonepay Is Now Available Through Multiple Banks 

Checkout by Fonepay is currently available through the mobile banking applications only* of several leading financial institutions, making it easier for customers across Nepal to experience the new checkout journey. 

Participating banking partners include: 

  • Agricultural Development Bank Limited 

  • Citizen Bank International Limited 

  • Everest Bank Limited 

  • Garima Bikas Bank Limited 

  • Jyoti Bikas Bank 

  • Kamana Sewa Bikas Bank Limited 

  • Kumari Bank Limited 

  • Laxmi Sunrise Bank Limited 

  • Machhapuchchhre Bank Limited 

  • Mahalaxmi Bikas Bank Limited 

  • Manjushree Finance Limited 

  • Muktinath Bikas Bank Limited 

  • Nabil Bank Limited 

  • Nepal Investment Megha Bank 

  • Prabhu Bank Limited 

  • Rastriya Banijya Bank Limited 

  • Sanima Bank Limited 

  • Shine Resunga development Bank Limited 

  • Siddhartha Bank Limited 

And this is only the beginning. More banks, financial institutions, and merchant platforms are expected to join Checkout by Fonepay in the coming months, bringing the service to even more customers across Nepal. 

From Shopping to Payment—Made Simpler 

The integration of Checkout by Fonepay with Jeevee represents another step toward making digital commerce more convenient for Nepali consumers. 

Instead of treating payment as a separate part of the shopping experience, Checkout by Fonepay brings a smoother payment journey directly into the online checkout process. 

For shoppers, that means fewer interruptions, less hassle, and a more convenient way to complete everyday online purchases.
